TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD494F INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
544111N 0011254W (HARTLEPOOL). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS)
UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG
SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT 
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. 
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT.
FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-5534/03.
